derived.comparison_definition: Candidate median divided by Python median; lower is better for wall time, total CPU and RSS. Win/tie/loss compares unrounded observed medians strictly, with no percent threshold or statistical significance claim. A zero Python median makes the ratio unavailable.
derived.total_cpu_definition: user_cpu_seconds + system_cpu_seconds for each measurement attempt; median/minimum/maximum are computed from those per-attempt totals, never from component medians.

environment.boundary: Linux guest ext filesystem; inputs and outputs staged before timing; VM and host storage remain part of the environment.

measurement_notes: Fresh processes; filesystem warmed by qualification.
Whiskers show observed minimum and maximum of four timings; these are descriptive ranges, not confidence intervals.
Peak RSS is for the entire process, in bytes; charts convert to MiB.
The 7200-second budget controls round admission and is not a hard elapsed-time cap.
Historical macOS and optimized-Python measurements are not pooled.
scope: Linux ARM64 Docker VM; observed fixture journeys only. No production x86 or bare-metal performance claim.
